claims.claim_text: Surveillance footage showed the subject striking vehicles and a fire hydrant with the pole.
The subject was holding a metal pole in his right hand.
Officers identified themselves and commanded the subject to drop the pole.
The subject advanced toward officers in an aggressive posture with the pole raised.
I deployed my TASER, which did not have the desired effect.
I then transitioned to my duty firearm.
I fired five rounds from my duty weapon.
Officers handcuffed the subject and began administering medical aid.
The subject communicated in Vietnamese during portions of the encounter.
